A 25-year-old student from Khammam in Telangana, Nallamala Akshita, died of a suspected heart attack in Albany, New York, U.S., on October 23, according to sources.
Daughter of Khammam-based trader Nallamala Anand, Askhita moved to the U.S. four years ago for higher education.
She recently completed her Master of Science (MS) degree and had been looking for job opportunities.
Her sudden death has left her family devastated, shattering their hopes for her future.
Meanwhile, BRS senior leader and former Khammam MP Nama Nageswara Rao expressed his condolences to her family over her untimely death.
